significance: A Chola-period Shiva temple at Cholapuram, on the Kumbakonam-Chennai road, whose presiding deity is Bhairavesvarar and whose goddess is Bhairavesvari. Only the base of its front mandapa survives, and it is known for housing sixty-four Bhairavas.
story: The place, once called Bhairavapuram, is held to be where Bhairava first appeared as a form of Shiva, and where all sixty-four Bhairavas manifested.
